remarks: Location, Location, Location! Lovely Over-sized 2 Bedroom Top Floor Unit in the Heart of Downtown, Units in this Well Maintained Building do not Come up Often, Don't Miss out! Walk to Shops, Restaurants, Bars, Theaters, Parks. Commuters' Dream, Train & Transportation Nearby, Convenient to I-95. Fully Equipped Kitchen with Gas/Oven Range, Stainless Steel Refrigerator and Backsplash. The Primary Bedroom Suite has a Walk-in Closet and a Full Bathroom. Across from Second Bedroom there is an Additional Full Bath with a Bathtub. Bright and Spacious Living room and Dining room Provides Plenty of Room for Entertainment. Lots of closets, Laundry in the Building, Heat and Hot Water are Included in Common Charges. Please Schedule your Private Tour Before it's Gone!!!!
